items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I played for Milton Berle, who had a lot of music...

ctx.x: So when did the first opportunity come up for you, that a pretty big name called you to work?

I got a job in the Catskills one summer. And all the big names came through. All the acts came through, from Milton Berle to Joan Rivers, everybody came through from New York. Some of them I got to play, some I didn’t because they carried their own drummers, but most of them I did. And it was kind of frightening coming from Springfield, Mass. but again someone knew me, a bass player that had heard me and recommended me for the job. And it was an exciting summer.
Did you get rehearsal time with these different people.
